name: Runemaster Leyline Magician cuts Primordial Pulse's cooldown on Primordial Blast cast (#3100)
contract: Leyline Magician 706823 Effect0 is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL, ProcChance 100, trigger 520146
matching the tooltip exactly). Spell.dbc ProcFlags is 0 and, before the fix, no spell_proc row existed, so
casting Primordial Blast never reduced Primordial Pulse's cooldown. Primordial Blast (800732) is family 38,
SpellFamilyFlags0/1/2 4194304/1048576/64, DmgClass magic, a harmful SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE hit: at cast
phase Spell.cpp sets PROC_FLAG_DONE_SPELL_MAGIC_DMG_CLASS_NEG (0x10000), so the fix scopes the row to that
ProcFlags, cast phase, Primordial Blast's own family/classmask.

steps.label: Fixture: mana pool for the Primordial Blast casts
SETUP: without the talent, casting Primordial Blast leaves the cooldown alone
CONTRACT: casting Primordial Blast removes 5 sec from Primordial Pulse
